_template: QUEST-002 verification-round manifest template (Elite-50 task 6, QUEST-002-SPEC.md). Replace every REPLACE_* value at registration; manifest_sha256 is computed over the final manifest text and stored with the quest row — it is not a field of the manifest itself. Delete this _template key before hashing.

claim.sha256: REPLACE — sha256 of the claim file bytes
claim.url: REPLACE — public URL of the claim file (replay-index: the chained artifact; replay-result: the bundle document)

deadline_utc: REPLACE — same instant in UTC, e.g. 2026-11-29T05:59:00Z

independence.human_review: operator independence is self-declared; Dennis Christie confirms separate operators, hosts and credentials before any settlement
ineligible_operators: REPLACE — the claim's author/submitter for this instance

reward.recipients: the two matching independent verifiers of the PASS pair: alpha (earlier accepted seal) and beta (later)
reward.reconciliation: funded escrows are reconciled to per_verifier_hhc x2 at settlement
reward.refusal_recipients: on a FAIL round (claim refused), the two matching independent REFUSAL verifiers are paid refusal_pay_hhc each — a referee who honestly refuses is not taxed for refusing (QUEST-002-SPEC.md §6)

round.metric: REPLACE — replay-result: the published metric, e.g. cases_passed; omit for replay-index
round.subject: REPLACE — what is being verified, in one line

round_output.result_hash: sha256(canonical_json(recomputed_result)); replay-index recomputed_result = {count, head_hash}; replay-result recomputed_result = {score, verdict} from the published grader
round_output.sealed_output: sha256(canonical_json(output)); canonical_json = sorted keys, separators (',',':'), UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False, no trailing newline
round_output.verdict: MATCH (recomputed result equals the claim) or REFUSAL (it does not; differing_field names the field that differs)

signature_rules.envelope_signature: over canonical_json of all envelope fields except signature and envelope_signature
signature_rules.key_id: sha256 of the 32 raw public-key bytes
signature_rules.signature: over UTF-8 bytes of the sealed_output hex string

spec.sha256: REPLACE — sha256 of the spec document at registration

title: REPLACE — e.g. Verification Round: <claim set name>
